messages:
oliver: Noticed a curious effect after running int4 mixed-per-channel quant for rerank-medium: ndcg@10 essentially flat but MRR@10 increases by ~4% on long queries while decreasing ~3% on short queries. opening a thread to capture hypotheses.

maya: interesting. dataset and slice defs? runner?

oliver: dataset = production_holdout_mar2026.jsonl. Slices: SHORT = query_len<=6, LONG = query_len>=30. runner: cuda with int4 kernel v1.2. numbers (float32 -> int4): SHORT ndcg@10 0.688 -> 0.687 (mrr 0.462 -> 0.448, -3.0%); LONG ndcg@10 0.635 -> 0.636 (mrr 0.321 -> 0.334, +4.0%).

anya: oppositely signed MRR deltas by length could indicate prefix kv cache/attention quant noise that affects early-token logits differently from later-context signals. int4 likely reduces dynamic range causing underflow on small-margin early ranks.

maya: can you share a couple qids that flip for each slice? also include tokenized prefixes and top5 logits for float vs int4.

oliver: two flip examples:
- qid 9001 SHORT: "install rpm for pkgX"
  tokens: ["install","rpm","for","pkgX"]
  float top5 logits: [3.21, 2.95, 1.12, 0.55, -0.2]
  int4 top5 logits: [2.98, 2.97, 1.10, 0.60, -0.1]
- qid 9002 LONG: "How do I migrate my cluster from kubernetes 1.18 to 1.24 while preserving..."
  tokens: ["How","do","I","migrate","my","cluster","from","kubernetes","1",".","18",... long]
  float top5 logits: [1.12, 0.98, 0.50, 0.10, -0.5]
  int4 top5 logits: [1.40, 0.95, 0.45, 0.05, -0.6]
notice int4 seems to compress high logits for short but amplify mid-ranked logits for long queries (maybe due to layernorm scaling variants).

maya: hypothesis: per-channel quant scales chosen by global percentile may be mis-calibrated for short context where a single strong feature dominates; for long contexts the aggregated signal benefits from noise injecting or rescaling. experiments: 1) recompute per-row scaling using a short-query focused calibration set, 2) try asymmetric quant (signed vs unsigned) for last projection, 3) run int4 with preserving topk logits in fp16 (hybrid topk).

oliver: queued jobs: 5398765432-jobA (short-calib scale), jobB (asymmetric-lastproj), jobC (hybrid-topk-fp16). eval-bot: please run with export of per-example top5 logits + per-layer activation percentiles.

eval-bot: Jobs submitted: 5398765432-jobA, 5398765432-jobB, 5398765432-jobC. Outputs will be saved to /runs/5398765432/*.

anya: long-term action: add a length-aware quant calibration routine to the PTQ pipeline that ensures worst-case P@1 delta < 1% across len buckets (<=6, 7-29, >=30). Also add a minimal 1k-prime short-query set to nightly smoke so we catch short-query top1 regressions early.

maya: agree. I'll draft a PR for length-aware calibration and the smoke prime. oliver, once job outputs are in, can you attach per-layer scale diagnostics?

oliver: will do. will post results in this thread. :magnifying_glass_tilted_left:
